item.title: Welcoming Our Second Daughter Miss. Jojo
item.description:
A Smooth Birth Experience

In September our family welcomed our second daughter into the world marking the beginning of a new chapter filled with joy and anticipation. We were released in 48 hours, mother and child are healthy and safe to home.

Special thanks to our friend who let our elder daughter stayed in their house for two days. …

item.title: Pico de Gallo, home recipes
item.description: I have an immense fondness for pico de gallo. Its tantalizing flavors make my mouth water. However, I often find myself dissatisfied with the portion served in stores. Determined to satisfy my cravings, I took matters into my own hands, making a generous amount while customizing the seasoning to perfectly suit my taste buds. ...
